correctness.rationale: Every matching of the ordinary wheel W_{n+1} has zero or one spoke, so X_n decomposes as R_n=Ind(C_n) plus n spoke cones u_i*Ind(P_{n−2}). Relative augmented chains decompose equivariantly by spoke and give a long exact sequence. Standard integral path and cycle independence-complex homotopy formulas produce exactly three residue cases: n=3k rim H~_{k−1}=Z² unchanged; n=3k+1 a kernel H~_{k−1}(R_n)⊗J_n in degree k and rank n−1; n=3k+2 a rank-1 rim injection with rank-n induced spoke-link quotient in an integral D_n exact sequence, with no asserted integral splitting. Reflection reversal on Ind(P_{3k}) has degree epsilon_k=(−1)^{k(k−1)/2}. Fixed orbit-independent-set path/cycle polynomial recurrence p_j=p_{j−1}−p_{j−2} yields explicit full rotation and both reflection character classes; rational splitting in third case uses Maschke only. Independently enumerated every matching face and signed dihedral Lefschetz trace for each of 204 elements across n=3..14 and verified rank/character formulas. The all-n proof uses the relative-chain exact sequence, not finite extrapolation.
